definitions.explanation: Vigorous and spirited exertion toward a goal. A formal word carrying a stronger sense of determined striving than simple effort, often used in business speeches and formal correspondence.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦{一同|いちどう}→一同：08918_ichidou⟧、{奮励|ふんれい}⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧。
examples.english: All employees will strive and work hard.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今後|こんご}→今後：02808_kongo⟧とも{奮励|ふんれい}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{業務|ぎょうむ}→業務：09630_gyoumu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}んで→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧まいります。
examples.english: I will continue to devote my utmost efforts to my work.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先人|せんじん}→先人：23803_senjin⟧たち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{奮励|ふんれい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧で、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{荒|あ}れ{地|ち}→荒れ地：20128_arechi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{豊|ゆた}か→豊か：03654_yutaka⟧な⟦{農地|のうち}→農地：14354_nouchi⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: Thanks to the strenuous efforts of our predecessors, this region was transformed from wasteland into fertile farmland.

notes:
A formal word expressing vigorous exertion and dedicated effort. Often used in business speeches, formal letters, and historical contexts. Carries a stronger sense of spirited determination than ⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧ alone.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {奮励努力|ふんれいどりょく}: strenuous effort (emphatic compound)
- {奮励|ふんれい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to strive, to exert oneself
- {奮励|ふんれい}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}む→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧: to tackle with vigorous effort

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧: effort — the most common and neutral term for effort
- ⟦{奮闘|ふんとう}→奮闘：07901_funtou⟧: hard fight, struggle — implies fighting against adversity
- ⟦{精進|しょうじん}→精進：13788_shoujin⟧: devotion, diligence — carries a spiritual or self-improvement nuance
- ⟦{尽力|じんりょく}→尽力：09336_jinryoku⟧: utmost effort — formal, often used for effort on behalf of others
